gate: H1c FGKMT Hypothesis 1 and Sono PAP source tracing
scope: Separate source traces for the average-discrepancy package used to verify FGKMT Hypothesis 1 and the pointwise lower-bound package called PAP by Sono. Shared zero-free and character-distribution inputs are recorded without asserting that either package implies the other.

status_vocabulary.EXACT_SUFFICIENT_REDUCTION: An elementary exact condition sufficient for the named Hypothesis 1 clause is derived, but the common numerical threshold has not been solved.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL_NUMERIC: A numerical exponent or constant is printed, while at least one multiplier or starting range remains missing.
status_vocabulary.SOURCE_CHAIN_TRACED: The primary and lower cited sources are identified, but no numerical package is recovered.
status_vocabulary.RATE_MISSING: The printed statement contains an implied constant, o term, or sufficiently-large range without a usable number.
status_vocabulary.SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: A cited proof must be reconstructed quantitatively before the row can be certified.
status_vocabulary.ALTERNATIVE_NOT_DIRECT_SUBSTITUTE: The source is explicitly quantitative but has hypotheses that do not cover the required modulus family without an additional proof reorganization.
status_vocabulary.LOGICAL_RELATION_CORRECTED: A prior dependency edge is removed because the two statements are distinct obligations sharing inputs rather than implications.
status_vocabulary.HARD_BLOCKER: The numerical package or common cutoff cannot be certified until all upstream rows close.

obligations.role: distribution of the integer interval in arithmetic progressions
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: For an interval containing N integers, each residue-class count differs from N/q by at most 1. Hence floor(y^(1/3))*(log y)^(100 k^2) <= N is an exact sufficient condition for clause (1).
missing_numeric_inputs: a common y satisfying this inequality together with every hard clause
exact endpoint conventions for the A(y) interval used in each application

obligations.role: no concentration of the integer interval in one residue class
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: The exact count is at most N/q+1. If N>=q this is at most 2N/q, giving an explicit sufficient constant 2 for clause (3).
missing_numeric_inputs: verification of N>=q over the exact common parameter range
composition with the same interval endpoint convention as clause (1)

obligations.role: effective Landau-Page dichotomy
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: FGKMT gives an effective zero-free alternative or one real quadratic exceptional character for Q>=100.
missing_numeric_inputs: the constant in 1-sigma >> 1/log(Q(1+|t|))
the constant in q_Q >> log^2 Q
a numerical range uniform in the later character sum

obligations.role: selection and size of the exceptional prime B
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: B is 1 or the largest prime factor of the exceptional conductor; log q_Q << B follows using the prime number theorem.
missing_numeric_inputs: the implied constant in log q_Q << B
an explicit PNT input and cutoff
the switch point between the exceptional and non-exceptional cases

obligations.role: effective primitive-character psi estimate
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: With Q=exp(c1 sqrt(log x)), FGKMT obtains a bound of shape x exp(-3c sqrt(log x)) for q<exp(2c sqrt(log x)), after choosing c1 sufficiently small.
missing_numeric_inputs: specific admissible c1 and c
the implied multiplier
the first x for all q,z and exceptional-prime cases

obligations.role: average prime discrepancy through Bombieri-Vinogradov
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: A standard Bombieri-Vinogradov proof yields a bound through q<x^(1/2-epsilon) with an exponential-decay term and the character sum from (7.2).
missing_numeric_inputs: a fixed numerical epsilon
all large-sieve and character-sum multipliers
a finite starting x and endpoint-uniform version

obligations.locator: FGKMT Lemma 7.2, conversion of L(n)=an+b to progressions
obligations.role: uniform affine-form to arithmetic-progression mapping
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: A residue class for n modulo q maps to a prime progression whose modulus includes |a|q and whose endpoints depend on ay+b.
missing_numeric_inputs: exact gcd and sign case splits
a finite inequality placing every |a|q inside the certified modulus range
exact endpoint and short-interval discrepancy bookkeeping

obligations.role: uniform positive lower estimate for represented primes
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: The discrepancy denominator uses the actual prime population represented by each selected linear form.
missing_numeric_inputs: an explicit PNT or PNT-in-AP lower bound on that population
prime-power and endpoint corrections
a common range uniform in all allowed a,b,y

obligations.locator: Composition of FGKMT Hypothesis 1(1)-(3) and Lemma 7.2
obligations.role: numerical Hypothesis 1 package for all required linear forms
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: Clauses (1) and (3) have elementary finite sufficient reductions, while clause (2) remains an average prime-distribution problem.
missing_numeric_inputs: all hard clause-(2) constants
one common cutoff satisfying the elementary and analytic clauses
a checked uniformity certificate for every form used by FGKMT

obligations.role: explicit zero-free-region input
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: Sono records McCurley's R=9.645908801... and uses the simplified choice c_ZFR=1/24.
missing_numeric_inputs: all subsidiary validity conditions from McCurley's theorem
the exact exceptional-zero case cutoff used in the PAP composition

obligations.locator: Sono Section 5, equation (5.2); Gallagher density theorem
obligations.role: zero-density estimate near sigma=1
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: Sono uses absolute constants a,b and later chooses a=(3/10)c_ZFR=1/80.
missing_numeric_inputs: the Vinogradov multiplier
the full numerical parameter range
the finite x at which the chosen a is valid in every case

obligations.role: zero-density exponent used to set D_PAP
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: Jutila's 1977 theorem gives exponent 6+epsilon in the high-alpha range; Sono combines ranges using c_ZD=16 and takes D_PAP=10c_ZD=160.
missing_numeric_inputs: the epsilon-dependent implied multiplier
the finite valid range
the numerical bridge between the high- and low-alpha cases

obligations.locator: Sono Section 5, invocation of Maier Lemma 2
obligations.role: transfer from density estimates to a pointwise progression lower bound
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: Sono states that Maier's proof is valid for x>=Q^(10 c_ZD).
missing_numeric_inputs: all constants and endpoint conditions inside Maier Lemma 2
a numerical verification that the Gallagher/Jutila inputs meet those conditions

obligations.locator: Sono Section 5, principal-character term after Maier Lemma 2
obligations.role: positive main term for psi(x;q,a)
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: The principal contribution is written as (1+o(1))x/phi(q).
missing_numeric_inputs: a one-sided numerical rate for the o(1) term
a finite starting x uniform over q

obligations.role: subtraction error below the principal term
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: The contribution is O_<= of x exp(-aD)/phi(q), leading formally to C_PAP=1-exp(-2) for a=1/80 and D=160.
missing_numeric_inputs: the finite cutoff hidden in O_<=
case-complete exceptional-character bookkeeping

obligations.locator: Sono Assumption 3.2, transition from weighted psi estimates to pi
obligations.role: prime-power removal and partial summation
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: The target is a lower bound for pi(x;q,a), while Section 5 works through character sums for psi.
missing_numeric_inputs: explicit prime-power error
one-sided partial-summation constants
endpoint and log variation bounds uniform in q

obligations.role: numerical PAP with C_PAP=1-e^-2 and D_PAP=160
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: The coefficient and exponent are explicit, but the theorem is still stated with 1+o(1) and sufficiently-large conditions.
missing_numeric_inputs: all upstream multipliers and cutoffs
a common q,x range including the exceptional case
an independently checked one-sided pi lower-bound certificate

obligations.role: candidate explicit Bombieri-Vinogradov input
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: The theorem supplies explicit constants for a restricted modulus family whose least prime factor exceeds a prescribed threshold.
missing_numeric_inputs: a proof reducing every required FGKMT modulus to the rough-modulus family
a complete treatment of the omitted small-prime-factor moduli
compatibility with the exceptional-prime and affine-form conditions

obligations.locator: Comparison of FGKMT Hypothesis 1(2) with Sono Assumption PAP
obligations.role: prevent a false implication in the proof DAG
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: Hypothesis 1(2) is an average discrepancy estimate through moduli up to y^(1/3); PAP is a pointwise lower bound with x>=q^160, hence q<=x^(1/160). They share analytic inputs but neither statement implies the other as printed.
missing_numeric_inputs: separate numerical closures for both sibling packages

obligations.locator: Joint downstream use in the Sono/FMT threshold proof
obligations.role: one x range satisfying the sibling Hypothesis 1 and PAP packages
obligations.printed_or_derived_information: The two packages may both be needed downstream, but they must be proved separately before their cutoffs can be maximized.
missing_numeric_inputs: a numerical Hypothesis 1 package
a numerical PAP package
all parameter translations to one common variable and range

canonical_corrections.reason: Sono reference [10] and the journal record identify volume 41 as 1977.
The average-discrepancy Hypothesis 1 package and pointwise PAP lower bound are sibling obligations, not logical implications.
